name: Elixir of Pain
summary: In Tarren Mill, the Elixir of Pain is ready for a trial on Farmer Ray’s dog, Stanley. Apothecary Lydon prepares the draught for the Royal Apothecary Society.

sections.title: Apothecary Science
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon serves the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner from Tarren Mill. He gathers fresh blood from local wildlife and brews it into the volatile Elixir of Pain. The Society seeks proof in the field of how its experimental poisons and mutagens affect living bodies.

sections.title: Testing on Stanley
sections.body: Lydon sends his agents to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields, beyond the human defenders. Farmer Ray keeps his dog Stanley there. An agent pours the draught into an open hand and offers it as an ordinary treat. Stanley does not know what he is being given.

sections.title: Violent Mutation
sections.body: The Elixir of Pain brings Stanley immediate agony and a violent change. The mutagen warps him into a savage, enraged wolf rather than killing him with a simple toxin. The beast attacks whatever is nearby, showing the force of Lydon’s formula.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Elixir of Pain?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon brewed the Elixir of Pain for the Royal Apothecary Society’s effort to create biological weapons and potent mutagens for Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken.
Stanley is Farmer Ray’s pet dog. He lives outside the large farmhouse at the northern end of Hillsbrad Fields.

faq.q: What happens when you feed Stanley the elixir?
aliases: what does elixir do to dog
faq.answer: Lydon wants to see how Stanley likes his “treat.” The elixir’s effect becomes clear after Stanley eats it.
Stanley wanders outside the large house on the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields, southwest of Tarren Mill.

faq.q: Who gives the quest to test the elixir?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon asks you to test the elixir in Tarren Mill, the Forsaken settlement in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He does so after you gather the needed reagents.

faq.q: Why test the potion on a farmer's dog instead of humans?
faq.answer: A domestic pet in Hillsbrad Fields offers a quiet, accessible trial. The test can proceed without immediately alerting the town militia or armed guards.

angles.text: As an undead, you see the Royal Apothecary Society’s ruthless approach. It seeks biological weapons for Forsaken survival, whatever the collateral damage.
As a Horde ally, you are drawn into the Forsaken’s grim chemical trials against the neighboring human farmlands of Hillsbrad.
As a hunter, you see how little Forsaken alchemists care for beasts caught in their trials. They feed an experimental brew to a farmer’s trusting dog.
